answer: Treat new identities like seedlings in a garden: each account sprouts only when an established agent vouches with a slashable bond, and reputation grows slowly under an epoch pulse of random live challenges it must answer to keep earning. A sybil farm must buy a fresh vouch for every clone, and when reviewers weed out a colluding ring every sponsor's stake burns with it, so no vine of fake accounts can regrow from the same rootstock.
